messages:
Anna: quick sync — let's unify routing/topology choices for multi-region + tenant isolation. Q2 roadmap gate next week.
Sam: +1. focus on 3 pillars: isolation lanes, routing guardrails, fallback tiers.
Miguel: also need launch criteria per pillar: SLO targets, infra readiness, migration playbooks.
Leila: enterprise asks: per-tenant SLA and region pinning — required for Dedicated/Private.
Priya: propose a compatibility matrix for model variants x region x fallback to avoid surprise degradation.
Anna: doc outline: goal/non-goals; principles; decision matrix (soft-evict/hard-evict/slice migrate); launch criteria; customer gating checklist; ops runbook.
Sam: decision heuristics suggestion:
- soft-evict: transient overload, same region, <5% traffic spike
- hard-evict: noisy neighbor causing SLA risk or measured error spikes
- slice-migrate: sustained imbalance, long-term rebalancing
Miguel: migration playbook should include rollback steps and example commands, e.g.:
```
# migrate slice
rctl migrate --slice s42 --to-region us-west-2 --dry-run
# rollback
rctl migrate --slice s42 --rollback
```
Leila: ops needs automated fallback: model-variant fallback + region fallback policy. For Private installs, call out: no automatic cross-region fallback unless customer opted in.
Priya: include cost impact notes per policy (token cost, reserved capacity billing). Also small explainer: latency vs isolation vs cost tradeoffs.
Anna: gating checklist (must pass all):
- infra: cross-region latency < target and heatmap validated
- perf: p50/p95 within SLO for routed paths
- reliability: automated fallback tested in staging
- migration: playbook + runbook + customer opt-in flags
- legal: cross-region data movement consent for Private installs
Sam: I'll draft principles + decision matrix by EOD Thu. Miguel: you own migration playbooks + rollback examples by Fri. Leila: ops runbook + alert thresholds. Priya: compatibility matrix template.
infra-bot: heatmap export: https://internal.redwood/diag/heatmap/2965432100 (CSV attached)
Miguel: add note: for air-gapped/private, migration is manual and surfaced in contract. Add checkbox in gating: "customer accepts no cross-region fallback".
Leila: ops will add alerts for: tenant CPU/GPU steal >10%, request error rate >1% over 5m, latency p95 > SLA.
Priya: I'll attach the compatibility matrix template in a follow-up thread.
Anna: target: draft in #architecture for review by Monday AM. Flag blockers now. :thumbsup:
Sam: pinging infra for the latest cross-region latency numbers.
